meaning_en: at a higher place than
example_en: The birds flew high above the trees.
examples_extra: The plane flew above the clouds.
Temperatures rose above thirty degrees yesterday.
note_fa: «یعنی «بالایِ»؛ برای عدد و سطح: above 30 degrees.»

meaning_en: in or to a foreign country
example_en: I want to study abroad next year.
examples_extra: They went abroad for their honeymoon.
He lived abroad for ten years.
note_fa: «قید است و حرف اضافه نمی‌گیرد: go abroad، نه go to abroad.»

meaning_en: following someone or something
example_en: The dog ran after the ball.
examples_extra: The dog ran after the ball into the street.
She looked after her younger brother all evening.

meaning_en: touching something or someone
example_en: He leaned his bike against the wall.
examples_extra: She leaned her bike against the wall.
He rested his head against the window and slept.

meaning_en: In the middle of several things or people.
example_en: The house is hidden among the trees.
examples_extra: She sat among her friends and laughed.
The money was shared equally among the winners.
note_fa: برای سه‌تا یا بیشتر؛ between برای دوتا.

meaning_en: Used to show an exact position or place.
example_en: I am waiting at the bus stop.
examples_extra: The train arrives at 7 o'clock in the evening.
She is waiting at the bus stop now.
note_fa: برای ساعت دقیق: at 5، ولی روزها on و ماه‌ها in.

meaning_en: In a specific place or location.
example_en: We met at the park yesterday.
examples_extra: We met at the restaurant near the park.
He works at a bank in the city centre.
note_fa: برای مکان مشخص: at the station، ولی شهرها in.

meaning_en: In your own house or apartment.
example_en: I like to relax at home on weekends.
examples_extra: She stayed at home because she was ill.
We watched a film at home last night.
note_fa: the ندارد: at home، نه at the home.

meaning_en: Not less than; minimum.
example_en: You should drink at least eight glasses of water.
examples_extra: You need at least two hours to finish the work.
At least 50 people came to the party.

meaning_en: Not here; to another place.
example_en: Go away and leave me alone.
examples_extra: He threw the ball far away into the garden.
She is away on holiday with friends this week.

meaning_en: At a distance from a place.
example_en: The shop is 5 miles away.
examples_extra: The beach is two miles away from here.
How far away is the nearest big hospital?
note_fa: فقط برای فاصله: two kilometres away.

meaning_en: The part of your body opposite your stomach.
example_en: My back hurts after carrying heavy bags.
examples_extra: I have a pain in my back after sitting at the desk all day.
He hurt his back when he lifted the heavy box alone.

meaning_en: In front of; ahead of.
example_en: The car stopped right before the gate.
examples_extra: The letter B comes before C in the alphabet.
She stood before the mirror and fixed her hair.
note_fa: به معنی «جلوتر از»؛ در ترتیب و ردیف هم می‌آید.

meaning_en: The start of something, a place or time.
example_en: The park is at the beginning of the street.
examples_extra: The beginning of the film was a little boring.
At the beginning of the lesson, she asked a question.
note_fa: «در آغاز»: at the beginning of the story.

meaning_en: In a lower place or position than.
example_en: The temperature is below zero today.
examples_extra: The temperature fell below zero during the night.
His photo is below the article on page ten.
note_fa: برای مکان و عدد: below zero یعنی «زیر صفر».

meaning_en: Under something, in a lower position.
example_en: The treasure was hidden beneath the old tree.
examples_extra: He found his phone beneath a pile of clothes.
The roots grow deep beneath the surface of the soil.

meaning_en: Next to someone or something.
example_en: She sat beside her friend.
examples_extra: She sat beside me on the long bus journey.
The hotel stands beside the river in the old town.
note_fa: یعنی «کنارِ»؛ با besides (علاوه بر) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: On the far side of something.
example_en: The mountains are beyond the river.
examples_extra: The farm lies beyond the river, near the old church.
The problem is beyond my understanding at the moment.
note_fa: به معنی «آن سویِ»: beyond the farm.

meaning_en: The lowest part of something.
example_en: The book fell to the bottom of the stairs.
examples_extra: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
Please sign your name at the bottom of the page.

meaning_en: The distance from one side to the other.
example_en: The breadth of the river was about 50 meters.
examples_extra: I admire the great breadth of her knowledge.
The river is about fifty metres in breadth.

meaning_en: Wide; covering a large area.
example_en: He has broad shoulders.
examples_extra: They live on a broad street near the city park.
She has a broad knowledge of European history.

meaning_en: make something wider or more general
example_en: Travel can broaden your mind.
examples_extra: Travelling to new countries really broadens your mind.
The evening course helped broaden her professional experience.
note_fa: بیشتر برای تجربه و دانش (به معنای مجازی).

meaning_en: willing to accept different ideas and opinions
example_en: She is very broadminded about other cultures.
examples_extra: My parents are quite broadminded about music and fashion.
A broadminded teacher listens carefully to every opinion.

meaning_en: Close to or next to a place.
example_en: The cafe is by the river.
examples_extra: Our small house is by the wide river.
She stood by the window, watching the heavy rain.

meaning_en: Positioned beside something or someone.
example_en: Sit by me on the sofa.
examples_extra: The new school is by the big city park.
Come and sit by me at dinner tonight.

meaning_en: Two or a few things or people.
example_en: I'll be back in a couple of minutes.
examples_extra: I saw him a couple of days ago.
We had a couple of problems.
note_fa: «چندتا»؛ a couple of یعنی دو یا چند.

meaning_en: Going far down from the surface.
example_en: The lake is very deep in the middle.
examples_extra: The lake is too deep to swim across safely.
He took a deep breath before starting his speech.
note_fa: معنای مجازی هم دارد: deep thought (فکر عمیق).

meaning_en: To make or become more deep.
example_en: The river deepens as it flows towards the sea.
examples_extra: Their friendship deepened over the years.
The crisis deepened fears about the economy.
note_fa: هم لازم هم متعدی: The river deepened / He deepened the hole.

meaning_en: The distance from the top to the bottom.
example_en: We measured the depth of the swimming pool.
examples_extra: The depth of the pool is two metres.
We discussed the issue in depth.
note_fa: in depth یعنی «به‌طور عمیق/مفصل»؛ جمعش depths (اعماق).

meaning_en: How far it is between two places.
example_en: What is the distance to the city center?
examples_extra: The distance from my home to school is about two kilometres.
She watched him from a safe distance.
note_fa: از نظر فاصله؛ in the distance یعنی «در دوردست».

meaning_en: Far away in space or time.
example_en: The distant mountains looked beautiful at sunset.
examples_extra: They could see the distant mountains from the beach.
She heard a distant voice calling her name.

meaning_en: Further along a road or path.
example_en: The shop is just down the street.
examples_extra: The bank is just down the road on the left.
Walk down the street and you will see it.
note_fa: یعنی «جلوتر در امتداد»؛ down the street یعنی آن‌طرف خیابان.

meaning_en: To a lower position or place.
example_en: Please sit down on the chair.
examples_extra: The lift took us down to the ground floor.
He climbed down the ladder carefully.
note_fa: یعنی به‌سمت پایین؛ متضادش up است.

meaning_en: The final part of something.
example_en: We live at the end of the street.
examples_extra: We stayed until the end of the film.
At the end of the street, turn left.
note_fa: at the end (در پایانِ چیزی) با in the end (سرانجام) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: Extremely large.
example_en: The elephant is an enormous animal.
examples_extra: They live in an enormous house by the lake.
The project will cost an enormous amount of money.

meaning_en: In all places.
example_en: I looked everywhere for my phone.
examples_extra: There were books and papers everywhere in his room.
Tourists come here from everywhere in the world.

meaning_en: To become bigger or make something bigger.
example_en: The company wants to expand its business next year.
examples_extra: The company plans to expand into Asian markets.
Metals expand when they are heated to high temperatures.

meaning_en: To make something longer or bigger.
example_en: We plan to extend our garden by a few meters.
examples_extra: We decided to extend our holiday by two days.
The company plans to extend its factory next year.

meaning_en: At or to a great distance.
example_en: How far is it to the next town?
examples_extra: The village is far from the city.
How far is the station from here?
note_fa: فاصله را با How far ...? می‌پرسند.

meaning_en: A long distance away.
example_en: She dreams of traveling to faraway lands.
examples_extra: They travelled to faraway lands.
She dreamed of faraway places.
note_fa: در کتاب معادل distant معرفی شده.

meaning_en: A unit of length, one foot is 30.48 cm.
example_en: The tree is about twenty feet tall.
examples_extra: The room is twelve feet wide.
He is six feet tall.

meaning_en: the part that faces forward.
example_en: The car's front is damaged.
examples_extra: The car is parked at the front of the house.
Write your name on the front of the paper.

meaning_en: Extremely large.
example_en: They built a giant new shopping mall.
examples_extra: They built a giant snowman in the park.
A giant wave hit the small boat.

meaning_en: How tall a person or thing is.
example_en: What is your height?
examples_extra: May I ask what your height is?
The garden wall is two metres in height.
note_fa: قد و ارتفاع؛ be afraid of heights.

meaning_en: To make something stronger or more intense.
example_en: The loud music heightened the excitement of the party.
examples_extra: The news heightened fears about the economy.
Bright colours heighten the beauty of the garden.

meaning_en: In this place.
example_en: Come here, please.
examples_extra: Please come and sit here right beside me.
The old book was here a minute ago.

meaning_en: Extending a long way up from the ground.
example_en: Mount Everest is a very high mountain.
examples_extra: Mount Damavand is a very high mountain.
The plane flew over the high mountains.
note_fa: برای کوه و ساختمان high؛ برای قد انسان tall.

meaning_en: The place where you live.
example_en: I want to go home now.
examples_extra: She went home early yesterday.
They have a beautiful home.

meaning_en: Used to ask about the measurement of something.
example_en: How long is the river?
examples_extra: How long is the film?
How wide is the river?

meaning_en: Very, very big.
example_en: They live in a huge house.
examples_extra: They live in a huge house.
The project was a huge success.

meaning_en: Inside a place or container.
example_en: The books are in the bag.
examples_extra: The keys are in the drawer.
She lives in a small village.

meaning_en: Located inside a specific area or building.
example_en: She lives in a small village.
examples_extra: The meeting is in the main hall.
He was born in a small town.

meaning_en: A unit of length, about 2.54 centimeters.
example_en: The screen is 15 inches wide.
examples_extra: The phone screen is six inches wide.
He missed the target by an inch.

meaning_en: To the inside of something.
example_en: She walked into the room.
examples_extra: She walked into the room.
Pour the milk into the glass.

meaning_en: The opposite direction to right.
example_en: Turn left at the traffic lights.
examples_extra: Take the first left turn after the bridge.
He has always written with his left hand.

meaning_en: How long something is from end to end.
example_en: The length of the room is five meters.
examples_extra: The length of the table is two metres.
What is the total length of the river?

meaning_en: To make something longer.
example_en: We need to lengthen the rope.
examples_extra: We need to lengthen the curtains a little.
They lengthened the school holidays by one week.

meaning_en: Very long, often too long.
example_en: The meeting was lengthy and boring.
examples_extra: The meeting was so lengthy that everyone felt tired.
He gave a lengthy explanation of the problem.

meaning_en: Measuring a great distance from end to end.
example_en: She has long hair.
examples_extra: She has very long hair.
It was a long and tiring journey.
note_fa: کتاب: My hair is very long؛ long هم صفت است هم قید (wait long).

meaning_en: travelling or communicating over a great distance.
example_en: She runs long-distance races every weekend.
examples_extra: He is a long-distance runner.
They had a long-distance relationship.
note_fa: کتاب: long-distance runner؛ برای مسافت/رابطه از راه دور.

meaning_en: not high; close to the ground.
example_en: The sun was low in the sky.
examples_extra: The ceiling is very low here.
Prices are low this season.
note_fa: کتاب: low door؛ هم «کوتاه» هم «پایین/کم» (قیمت، صدا).

meaning_en: make something less in amount or degree.
example_en: You should lower your blood pressure.
examples_extra: The shop lowered its prices.
Please lower your voice a little.

meaning_en: A hard, shiny material like iron or gold.
example_en: This table is made of metal.
examples_extra: The gate is made of metal.
Gold and silver are precious metals.

meaning_en: The central point or part.
example_en: The book is in the middle of the table.
examples_extra: He sat in the middle of the room.
Divide the cake down the middle.

meaning_en: A unit of distance, about 1.6 kilometers.
example_en: The nearest town is five miles away.
examples_extra: The station is half a mile away.
A mile is about 1.6 kilometres.

meaning_en: Not wide; having little width.
example_en: The road was very narrow.
examples_extra: The old street is too narrow for cars.
They won the match by a narrow margin.

meaning_en: Not open to new ideas or opinions.
example_en: He is too narrow-minded to accept new ideas.
examples_extra: He is too narrow-minded to listen properly.
Don't be so narrow-minded about new ideas.

meaning_en: Closest in distance.
example_en: Where is the nearest bus stop?
examples_extra: Excuse me, where is the nearest train station?
The nearest small town is ten miles away.

meaning_en: Positioned above and touching something.
example_en: The book is on the table.
examples_extra: The book is on the table.
She put the keys on the shelf.
note_fa: برای سطح تماس: on the table؛ برای روزها: on Monday.

meaning_en: Located at a specific place or surface.
example_en: The picture is on the wall.
examples_extra: They live on Baker Street.
The hotel is on the main road.
note_fa: برای خیابان و مکان: on Baker Street.

meaning_en: To the left side.
example_en: The shop is on the left.
examples_extra: The bank is on the left.
Turn on the left after the bridge.
note_fa: on the left یعنی سمت چپ؛ متضادش on the right.

meaning_en: To the right side.
example_en: The park is on the right.
examples_extra: The school is on the right.
You will see it on the right.
note_fa: on the right یعنی سمت راست.

meaning_en: Away from a place or inside.
example_en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
examples_extra: She ran out of the room quickly.
Let's eat out together tonight.

meaning_en: From inside to outside.
example_en: He took a book out of his bag.
examples_extra: She got out of the car.
He walked out of the room.

meaning_en: Moving from one side to another, often above.
example_en: The bird flew over the house.
examples_extra: The plane flew over the mountains.
He jumped over the fence.

meaning_en: The place where someone or something is.
example_en: What is your current position?
examples_extra: What is your exact position?
She changed her sitting position.

meaning_en: a long distance
example_en: It's quite a long way to the beach.
examples_extra: It's quite a long way to the station.
We walked quite a long way.

meaning_en: On the side that is not left.
example_en: Turn right at the traffic lights.
examples_extra: Turn right at the next traffic lights.
She guessed right on the final question.

meaning_en: Exactly or precisely.
example_en: The shop is right next to the bank.
examples_extra: The bank is right in the city centre.
He sat right next to the window.

meaning_en: Moving in a circle or curve.
example_en: We walked round the lake.
examples_extra: The children ran round the garden.
The moon travels round the Earth.

meaning_en: Very near, happening soon.
example_en: The shop is just round the corner.
examples_extra: Spring is just round the corner.
The shop is right round the corner.

meaning_en: not deep
example_en: The water in the pool is very shallow.
examples_extra: The water is quite shallow here.
The pool has a shallow end.

meaning_en: A quicker way to get somewhere.
example_en: Let's take a shortcut through the park.
examples_extra: We took a handy shortcut through the park.
Sadly, there are no shortcuts to real success.

meaning_en: To make something shorter.
example_en: Can you shorten these trousers for me?
examples_extra: Can you please shorten these long trousers a bit?
They wisely shortened the long meeting today.

meaning_en: A part of your body between your ribs and hip.
example_en: I have a pain in my side.
examples_extra: He always sleeps on his left side now.
Please park on the left side of the road.

meaning_en: How big or small something is.
example_en: What size is this shirt?
examples_extra: What size are your shoes?
The size of the room is perfect.

meaning_en: Affect a larger area or more people.
example_en: The disease spread quickly in the city.
examples_extra: News of their win spread very quickly.
Please spread the butter on the toast.

meaning_en: To extend over an area or distance.
example_en: The road stretches for miles.
examples_extra: The long sandy beach stretches for miles.
Always stretch your arms well before running.

meaning_en: Having a great height.
example_en: That is a very tall building.
examples_extra: He is a tall person.
It is a tall building.

meaning_en: In or at that place.
example_en: The book is over there.
examples_extra: Put the bag over there by the door.
There is a small lake behind our house.
note_fa: آنجا؛ در یا به آن مکان.

meaning_en: having a large distance between opposite sides.
example_en: The book has a very thick cover.
examples_extra: The book has a thick cover and heavy pages.
Fog was so thick that cars moved very slowly.

meaning_en: having little fat on the body.
example_en: She is tall and very thin.
examples_extra: He was so thin that his clothes hung loosely.
Slice the onion into thin rings for the salad.
note_fa: لاغر؛ چربی کم بدن. slim مؤدبانه‌تر است.

meaning_en: from one side or end to the other.
example_en: We walked through the forest.
examples_extra: The train goes through three tunnels on this route.
She looked through the window at the garden.
note_fa: از میان؛ از یک سمت به سمت دیگر.

meaning_en: extremely small.
example_en: The baby wore tiny shoes.
examples_extra: A tiny bird sat on the window sill.
The baby held my finger with her tiny hand.

meaning_en: A piece of clothing worn on the upper body.
example_en: She bought a new blue top.
examples_extra: She wore a pretty red top and jeans.
This blue top goes well with your skirt.

meaning_en: In the direction of.
example_en: She walked towards the door.
examples_extra: She walked slowly towards the bright city lights.
He is always kind towards his younger sister.
note_fa: «به‌سمت»؛ در آمریکا toward هم رایج است.

meaning_en: Moving below or beneath something.
example_en: The cat ran under the table.
examples_extra: The cat hid under the bed.
They walked slowly under the bridge.
note_fa: زیر (حرکت یا موقعیت)؛ under the table.

meaning_en: Directly below something else.
example_en: The cat is hiding underneath the bed.
examples_extra: The keys are underneath the book.
She wore a sweater underneath the coat.
note_fa: مستقیماً زیر چیزی؛ underneath the sofa.

meaning_en: Towards a higher place or further along a path.
example_en: The shop is just up the road.
examples_extra: Walk up the hill slowly.
The shop is further up the road.
note_fa: up یعنی به‌سمت بالا یا جلوتر.

meaning_en: measuring a large distance from side to side
example_en: The river is very wide here.
examples_extra: They offer a wide range of courses.
The river is very wide here.

meaning_en: having a large distance from side to side
example_en: The road is wide enough for two cars.
examples_extra: The road is wide enough for two cars.
She has a wide smile.

meaning_en: to make or become wider
example_en: They plan to widen the road.
examples_extra: They plan to widen the road.
The river widens near the sea.

meaning_en: the distance from side to side
example_en: What is the width of the table?
examples_extra: Measure the width of the table.
The width is fifty centimetres.

meaning_en: An area of ground next to a house.
example_en: The children played in the yard.
examples_extra: The children played in the yard.
Our house has a big yard.
